<translated_code>
import sys
from collections import deque

MAXN = 200
MAXM = 100000
INF = 199999999

grid = [[0]*20 for _ in range(20)]
mat = [[-1]*MAXN for _ in range(MAXN)]
n = 0
N = 0
T = 0
hu = [[0]*3 for _ in range(MAXN)]
re = [[0]*3 for _ in range(MAXN)]
zr = 0
zc = 0
cx = 0
cy = 0
dirs = [(0,-1),(0,1),(-1,0),(1,0)]

def isok(r, c):
    if 1 <= r <= n and 1 <= c <= n and grid[r][c] != -1:
        return (r-1)*n + c
    return -1

def BG():
    global N, mat
    N = n * n
    mat = [[-1]* (N+1) for _ in range(N+1)]
    for r in range(1, n+1):
        for c in range(1, n+1):
            if grid[r][c] == -1:
                continue
            p = (r-1)*n + c
            mat[p][p] = 0
            for d in range(4):
                nr = r + dirs[d][0]
                nc = c + dirs[d][1]
                if 1 <= nr <= n and 1 <= nc <= n and grid[nr][nc] != -1:
                    np = (nr-1)*n + nc
                    mat[p][np] = 1

dis = [0]*MAXN
def spfa():
    global dis
    for i in range(1, N+1):
        dis[i] = INF
    start = (zr-1)*n + zc
    dis[start] = 0
    q = deque([start])
    while q:
        u = q.popleft()
        for v in range(1, N+1):
            if mat[u][v] == 1 and dis[v] > dis[u] + 1:
                dis[v] = dis[u] + 1
                q.append(v)

def Floyd():
    for k in range(1, N+1):
        for i in range(1, N+1):
            if mat[i][k] == -1:
                continue
            for j in range(1, N+1):
                if mat[k][j] == -1:
                    continue
                if mat[i][j] == -1 or mat[i][j] > mat[i][k] + mat[k][j]:
                    mat[i][j] = mat[i][k] + mat[k][j]

class Edge:
    def __init__(self, st, ed, flow, next):
        self.st = st
        self.ed = ed
        self.flow = flow
        self.next = next

edge = [None]*MAXM
head = [-1]*MAXN
E = 0
src = 0
dest = 0

def addedge(st, ed, flow):
    global E
    edge[E] = Edge(st, ed, flow, head[st])
    head[st] = E
    E += 1
    edge[E] = Edge(ed, st, 0, head[ed])
    head[ed] = E
    E += 1

def BF():
    global head, E, src, dest
    head = [-1]*MAXN
    E = 0
    src = 0
    dest = cx + cy + 1
    for i in range(1, cx+1):
        addedge(src, i, hu[i][2])
    for i in range(1, cy+1):
        addedge(cx + i, dest, re[i][2])
    for i in range(1, cx+1):
        for j in range(1, cy+1):
            p1 = (hu[i][0]-1)*n + hu[i][1]
            p2 = (re[j][0]-1)*n + re[j][1]
            if mat[p1][p2] != -1 and mat[p1][p2] <= T and mat[p1][p2] < dis[p2]:
                addedge(i, cx + j, INF)
            elif mat[p1][p2] != -1 and mat[p1][p2] <= T and mat[p1][p2] == dis[p2]:
                for d in range(4):
                    rr = re[j][0] + dirs[d][0]
                    cc = re[j][1] + dirs[d][1]
                    pp = isok(rr, cc)
                    if pp != -1:
                        if mat[p1][pp] == mat[p1][p2] - 1 and mat[p1][pp] < dis[pp]:
                            addedge(i, cx + j, INF)
                            break

d = [-1]*MAXN
def dinic_bfs():
    global d
    q = deque([src])
    d = [-1]*MAXN
    d[src] = 0
    while q:
        u = q.popleft()
        i = head[u]
        while i != -1:
            v = edge[i].ed
            if d[v] == -1 and edge[i].flow > 0:
                d[v] = d[u] + 1
                if v == dest:
                    return True
                q.append(v)
            i = edge[i].next
    return False

stk = [0]*MAXN
cur = [0]*MAXN

def dinic():
    ret = 0
    while dinic_bfs():
        u = src
        tail = 0
        for i in range(src, dest+1):
            cur[i] = head[i]
        while cur[src] != -1:
            if u != dest and cur[u] != -1 and edge[cur[u]].flow > 0 and d[u] != -1 and d[u] + 1 == d[edge[cur[u]].ed]:
                stk[tail] = cur[u]
                tail += 1
                u = edge[cur[u]].ed
            elif u == dest:
                minf = INF
                for i in range(tail-1, -1, -1):
                    if edge[stk[i]].flow < minf:
                        minf = edge[stk[i]].flow
                ret += minf
                for i in range(tail-1, -1, -1):
                    edge[stk[i]].flow -= minf
                    edge[stk[i]^1].flow += minf
                    if edge[stk[i]].flow == 0:
                        tail = i
                u = edge[stk[tail]].st
            else:
                while tail > 0 and u != src and cur[u] == -1:
                    tail -= 1
                    u = edge[stk[tail]].st
                cur[u] = edge[cur[u]].next
    return ret

def solve():
    global grid
    grid[zr][zc] = 0
    BG()
    spfa()
    grid[zr][zc] = -1
    BG()
    Floyd()
    BF()
    return dinic()

def main():
    global n, T, cx, cy, grid, hu, re, zr, zc
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    it = iter(data)
    n = int(next(it))
    T = int(next(it))
    cx = 0
    cy = 0
    grid = [[0]*20 for _ in range(20)]
    for i in range(1, n+1):
        s = next(it)
        for j, ch in enumerate(s):
            if ch == 'Y':
                grid[i][j+1] = -1
            elif ch == 'Z':
                zr = i
                zc = j+1
                grid[i][j+1] = -1
            elif '0' < ch <= '9':
                cx += 1
                hu[cx][0] = i
                hu[cx][1] = j+1
                hu[cx][2] = ord(ch) - ord('0')
    for i in range(1, n+1):
        s = next(it)
        for j, ch in enumerate(s):
            if '0' < ch <= '9':
                cy += 1
                re[cy][0] = i
                re[cy][1] = j+1
                re[cy][2] = ord(ch) - ord('0')
    print(solve())

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
